title: ApproxGNN: A Pretrained GNN for Parameter Prediction in Design Space Exploration for Approximate Computing
problem: Design space exploration for approximate accelerators requires expensive evaluation of QoR-cost tradeoffs for many parameter configurations.
motivation: Efficient parameter prediction accelerates design space exploration and enables rapid prototyping of approximate accelerators.
method: Graph Neural Network trained to predict quality-of-result and cost metrics. Transfer learning approach with pre-trained model. Generalizes across multiple approximate computing scenarios.
key_novelty: First pre-trained GNN for approximate computing design space exploration with transfer learning capability.
contributions: GNN model for QoR/cost prediction in approximate computing
limitations: Transfer learning scope and generalization to novel approximate computing paradigms not detailed.
